lines.account: Loss on Sale of Trading Securities

notes: Period-end-only method: the June 12 sale is recorded against amortized cost with no entry to Fair Value Adjustment-TS, so the realized loss is 33,800 - 35,000 = (1,200). At 12/31/Y2 the remaining portfolio needs a debit FVA balance of 600 (85,600 - 85,000); the account starts with a 3,200 credit, so a 3,800 debit adjustment is required, recognizing a 3,800 unrealized holding gain in income. Net Year 2 effect = 3,800 - 1,200 = 2,600 increase.
